EC1: Coagulopathies (with prothrombin concentration [OR] less than 60% or INR more than 1.5)
EC3: Infection [OR] or injury [OR] or a lesion at the block site.
EC4: Suspected cervical vertebral column injury necessitating using a neck collar.
EC5: A compromised lung on the contralateral side of the block (Pneumothorax [OR], hemothorax [OR] or Pneumonectomy).
EC6: Traumatic vascular injuries [OR] or operative interventions (Surgical harvesting) involving arteries of the upper limb on the operative side.
EC8: Hypersensitivity to local anesthetics [OR] and/or Dexamethasone.
